entry.name: jit.uldl
entry.description: The jit.uldl object provides asynchronous file upload and download. Download is possible from http://, https://, ftp://, and file:/// URLs. Upload is only possible to ftp:// URLs.

messages.name: abort
messages.description: Aborts a download or upload operation in progress.

messages.name: download
messages.description: Begins a download operation from the URL specified in the argument. Any data is downloaded to the default path or the directory specified by theattribute. If no argument is given, download begins from the URL specified by theattribute. If the argumentis given, data will be downloaded to a Jitter matrix, and output via theobject's left (matrix) outlet.

messages.name: upload
messages.description: Begins an upload operation from the local file specified by the first argument, to the URL specified in the second argument. If no second argument is given, upload is to the URL specified by theattribute.
